meta.title: Send us your feedback
meta.subtitle: Found a bug, have an idea, or just want to tell us what you think? Fill in the form below. We read every message and use it to make the app better.

form.title: Feedback form
form.open: Open it in a new tab

details: Include version 0.2.4, your operating system, what you tried and what happened. A short example with fictional data is enough.
privacy: Do not send client names, case documents, passwords, recovery keys or backups. The embedded feedback form is provided by Google Forms. Information you submit is sent to Google Forms. This website and installer downloads use Cloudflare hosting, which processes standard connection metadata such as IP addresses. Website language and theme preferences are saved in your browser.
